d:
Long, straight, raven black hair with blunt-cut bangs and two long strands framing the face. Sharp, narrow, deep crimson eyes. Appears in mid-teens with a stoic expression. Slender, petite build. A traditional black and red Japanese-style kimono with intricate gold floral embroidery. Features long, flowing red ribbons tied to the hair and a traditional folding fan.
BODY COLOR: fair skin
